welcome: Welcome to The Markk Brandon Collective — everything I've been building out of Sacramento. Late nights. Real backends. No "book a demo" nonsense. Some apps started because I got sick of tools charging for basics — those stay free to use, no matter what. Others — StrainVerse, SpiritsVerse, CookVerse — started as late-night ideas and stuck around because people actually used them.

Before the web apps I ran game servers for five years — Minecraft, FiveM, Assetto Corsa, Beaming, and yes, a Roblox server. Communities don't stick around for a pretty landing page; they stick around when stuff works.
Three doors: browse and install apps here in MBC Store, chip in on GoFundMe if something helped you, or hire me if you want your own site or app built.
bio: I'm the developer behind The Markk Brandon Collective — full-stack websites and apps built out of Sacramento. Late nights, real backends, no fluff.

I write and ship in Cursor, track everything on GitHub, host on Cloudflare Pages and Workers, and point domains with GoDaddy. AI speeds up the typing. I still own the architecture, the deploys, and the 2 a.m. fix when something breaks.

aiNote.label: Real talk, up front
paragraphs: I use AI. Not hiding it. One-prompt "apps" are usually a front page and a dead button — that is not what I built here.
What's in this store is full-stack work: logins, databases, permissions, APIs, Android builds you can install. Products, not previews.
Open an app, sideload an APK, use it for real — that's what all of this is for.

support.title: Keep it running
